tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gshin po 'drer 'ong ba mi 'ong ba'i shog dril bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru/ gshin po 'dre ru yong ba mi 'ong ba'i thabs ni/ sātstsha dkar po gcig btab ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ mdun du trāṃ las rin po che'i mchod sdong gcig bsam/ de'i rtser skad cig gis gu ru padma chu dar sngon po dang sha yi yib zhu mnabs pa/ phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis thod pa lcang lo gnyis kha sprad pa'i bar du sdig can 'thag par bsam/ de la mchod pa lnga dbul/ gtor ma dmar po byin gyis brlabs te bsngos la/ bstod pa bya/ de nas sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐ zhes brgya rtsa bzla/ de nas gshin po'i ling ga la ming rus bris la/ dgug gzhug byas la sātstsha'i nang du gzhug /de nas bdag byin rlabs la sātstsha gdab pa ni/ sngags bzlas shing gu ru krong krong bsam/ rab gnas bya/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi srung ma la gtor ma dbul/ bkra shis bya/ smon lam gdab/ bsod nams shin tu che'o//
